node.title: Re^18: How do I display only matches
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
although it was a no-op when I learned Perl in the 5.6 era

True, although I think that pre-5.8 knowledge is the source of much of the misinformation in this subthread - that's when [doc://PerlIO] was [doc://perl58delta#PerlIO-is-Now-The-Default|made the default]. (OTOH, interestingly, the relevant parts of the section [doc://perlport#Newlines|Newlines in perlport] has remained pretty much unchanged since its introduction about 20 years ago in 5.005.)

So it is now equivalent to binmode FILEHANDLE, ':raw'?

Well, to be nitpicky, it [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/16fe6d5906f6eff9da00cb861a7054a440d1f6eb#diff-53ebe8584f9fd5c66d93ea1e04fffd38R450|always was] documented to be so, since the second argument was [doc://perl56delta#binmode()-can-be-used-to-set-:crlf-and-:raw-modes|introduced] in v5.6.
